name: QWEN-MODEL2-ALLOC-1
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-MODEL2-ALLOC-1. First prereg carrying the executable two-gate law: every bar declares gate_class; refutation_precedence names sanity bars only (validator-enforced). All X/K quantities are HELD-OUT-surface readings (evals/qwen_model2, frozen pre-compose); the MODEL-1 surface is the development surface and adjudicates nothing. dX(P|FLe) = X(FLe) - X(P) on the new surface, K analogue. Crossover floor-multiples are signed: (X_PK - X_PX)/f_X and (K_PX - K_PK)/f_K, floors per-contrast max over the four held-out receipts. Transport deviations are absolute nats v the registered F-conditioned marginals (0.128 X-mid, 0.0401 K-late) — science bands, never floors. Refutation predicate: min of the two signed crossover floor-multiples; below -5 = either leg materially reversed = the registered crossover failed. Both-legs inversion books as the stronger kill in prose only.

PX.description: FLe + C's S16 mid-linear band (layers 21-41, 48 keys, +461276672 bytes exactly)

PK.description: FLe + C's S16 late-linear band (layers 42-62, 48 keys, +461276672 bytes exactly)

FLe.description: frozen FLe artifact rescored on the held-out surface (marginal base)

C.description: frozen C artifact rescored on the held-out surface (ladder endpoint, desk color)

bars.name: SANITY-TREATMENT
bars.description: zero compose-admissibility violations (base FLe/donor C/mark/frozen band layers/48 keys/exact 461276672 bytes/chain identity) and cpu traversal 48/16 on all four held-out receipts

bars.name: CROSSOVER-X
bars.description: (X_PK - X_PX)/f_X above 5: mid is the X pick at equal spend

bars.name: CROSSOVER-K
bars.description: (K_PX - K_PK)/f_K above 5: late is the K pick at equal spend

refuted_if: The transport prior is refuted if EITHER crossover leg reads reversed past 5 floors on the held-out surface (predicate: min of the two signed crossover floor-multiples below -5). Both-legs inversion books additionally as the stronger kill in prose. Range excursions never suppress this; only bar 1 (sanity) does, via refutation_precedence.
registered_prior: House + GPT seat, medium: both crossover legs fire (the F-conditioned LBAND table transports in sign to the FLe base and the new surface); transport bands hold within 0.05/0.03 nats (weaker prior — surface change and one stacking level both untested). Bars 2-3 firing with 4-5 missing books TRANSPORT-DRIFT, not allocation failure.
